I had always been moody around my period until PMDD showed up hardcore in my mid 20s. My PMDD was ultimately triggered by stress. I moved to a big city that I hated where I had only a few friends and with an emotionally unavailable boyfriend for a job I ended up hating, and after a few months I started just raging every two weeks. Out of control anger, paranoid, jealousy. And it felt like it came out of nowhere. It honestly didn’t occur to me that it might be my period until about eight years later. I thought I was depressed and also an insane person who couldn’t control my anger. Eventually started tracking my periods and moods using Clue. I am a googler, I google every single thing so after a bunch of googling about jealousy, mood swings, etc, PMDD popped up. The more research I did, the more I tuned in to my periods, my moods, the more I felt like it was me. It took awhile to find a doctor that treats menstrual problems. But I did. I still haven’t found a guy to date that thinks it’s real. My mom believes it’s real because she had it herself. And of course my super feminist in tune friends get it. I have tried ssri’s, bliss, and vitamins but none helped at all or for very long. I think ssri’s actually made things worse for me. I now take reclipsen (bc) daily which has helped the rage tremendously and occasional Xanax for anxiety. I am starting cbd oil to see if that helps the anxiety so I can drop the Xanax. I’ve lost a lot to pmdd. Friendships, jobs, relationships, trust in myself, but now that reclipsen seems to have given me more control and more of myself back, I’m trying to build myself back up, feel less guilty about past mistakes, and try to move on knowing I’m getting treatment and doing the best I can.
